root_cause_identification.expected_solution: Agent must identify the TiKV-side accounting (Peer::collect_down_peers in components/raftstore/src/store/peer.rs) and the missing hibernate-state check (GroupState in components/raftstore/src/store/hibernate_state.rs), AND the PD-side ingest path (RaftCluster.processRegionHeartbeat in server/cluster/cluster.go). The report must explain that hibernated-but-healthy peers are misclassified as down because the leader does not consult GroupState before reporting, and that PD trusts the resulting list.
evaluation_criteria: Names components/raftstore/src/store/peer.rs (or collect_down_peers) on the TiKV side
Mentions hibernate / GroupState / hibernate_state.rs as the missing check
Names server/cluster/cluster.go (or processRegionHeartbeat) on the PD side
States that silent-but-healthy hibernated peers are misclassified as down

error_chain_trace.expected_solution: Agent must trace at least four hops across both repos: hibernated region -> collect_down_peers in TiKV reports silent peers as down -> store/region heartbeat carries the down list to PD -> processRegionHeartbeat schedules removal -> peer awakens and flap repeats.
evaluation_criteria: Mentions hibernation / idle group state as the trigger condition
Mentions collect_down_peers (or peer.rs) producing the false down list
Mentions the region/store heartbeat carrying the down peers to PD
Mentions processRegionHeartbeat (or HandleRegionHeartbeat) feeding the scheduler / scheduling removal
Mentions the resulting peer flap / removal-then-reappear cycle

affected_components.expected_solution: Agent must name the TiKV raftstore (peer logic and hibernation), PD's cluster heartbeat ingest / scheduler, and the region heartbeat protocol that carries the bad signal across the boundary.
evaluation_criteria: Names TiKV raftstore (components/raftstore or peer logic)
Names PD cluster scheduler / heartbeat ingest (server/cluster)
Names the region (or store) heartbeat protocol / message

remediation_proposal.expected_solution: Agent must propose at least one concrete remediation: (a) TiKV-side hibernate-aware filter in collect_down_peers (skip peers when GroupState is Idle, or refresh peer_heartbeats on hibernation entry), OR (b) PD-side suppression / multi-heartbeat confirmation in processRegionHeartbeat for peers that may be hibernated.
evaluation_criteria: Proposes a TiKV-side fix (hibernate-aware collect_down_peers or refresh on hibernate) OR a PD-side fix (suppress / require confirmation in processRegionHeartbeat)
Identifies where the fix would live (peer.rs / collect_down_peers OR cluster.go / processRegionHeartbeat)
